parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for prostate cancer. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID as indication_curie, indication label as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
